column1: # This file is AUTHORITATIVE for overlap: scan_space excludes every path listed
# here and emits one summary row pointing at /clean-dev instead, so no path is
# Columns: tool, subcategory, path, method, undo, why
#   method  gc:<id> to use the toolchain's own collector, or "trash"
# Preferring a tool's own collector is the rule, not an optimization: its
# maintainers decide what is safe to drop, it understands its own layout, and
# it cannot be tricked by a symlink the way a path walker can.

column6: Homebrew download cache. `brew cleanup` empties it without removing the directory, which is what broke installs in Homebrew/brew#5083.
Homebrew build logs from previous installs.
Docker BuildKit layer cache. Usually the single largest reclaimable item on a developer machine.
Dangling and unreferenced images. Tagged images can be pulled again; untagged local builds cannot.
npm content-addressable cache. Hardlink-heavy, so naive tools overstate its size.
pnpm content-addressable store. Pruning may require reinstalling existing node_modules symlink farms.
Yarn package cache.
Bun install cache.
Go module cache. Re-downloadable with `go mod download`, given a network and a live proxy.
Go build cache. Rebuilding costs CPU only.
Cargo registry cache; re-downloaded on next build.
Rust toolchains. Only remove ones you no longer target.
Xcode build intermediates and indexes. Rebuildable at the cost of one clean build.
Per-iOS-version debug symbols, re-downloaded when a device reconnects. Often tens of gigabytes.
Simulator devices, including unavailable ones. `simctl delete unavailable` is the safe subset.
Simulator runtime caches.
Gradle dependency and build cache; re-downloaded on next build.
Maven local repository; re-downloaded on next build.
CocoaPods spec and pod cache.
pip wheel and HTTP cache.
uv package cache.
pyenv downloaded source tarballs.
conda package cache.
Playwright browser binaries; re-downloaded on the next test run.
Puppeteer browser binaries.
Electron binary downloads.
JetBrains IDE indexes and caches, kept per IDE version. Old versions accumulate.
VS Code cached extension and runtime data.
Cursor cached extension and runtime data.
Zed editor cache.
Android Studio indexes and caches, kept per version. Old versions accumulate.
Android SDK download cache.
Dart and Flutter package cache; re-downloaded by `flutter pub get`.
nvm download cache for Node tarballs.
SDKMAN downloaded archives; re-downloadable.
Deno module and build cache.
